children.title: Path Dependence and Value Divergence: Revised Synthesis

detail.title: Path Dependence and Value Divergence: Revised Synthesis
detail.summary: This synthesis links mathematical optimization formulations (e.g., reverse-KL regularization) with institutional black-box design to explain observed value divergence in evolving systems, addressing the path-dependent nature of preference formation.
detail.reason: Revising the synthesis to incorporate new evidence on mathematical constraints in reinforcement learning and their impact on policy formation.
